title: Audit seven-source gap traversal and caller exhaustion
body:
## Summary

```text
PR3276 search/exhaustion audit
  -> actual gap traversal, independently ranked at every leaf
  -> exact full-caller selection and incomplete-receipt rejection
  -> full scientific B census remains separate
```

Close PR3276's explicit gap-enumeration/caller handoff in `research/connector-caller-exhaustion-audit/`. The written argument and source-bound tests found no defect at this boundary. Capacity and search are explicit audit test doubles; synthetic process receipts are not exclusion evidence. No complete f(7) theorem, supplier admission, new kappa or selected-frontier change.

Task `census-pruning-audit`, refined scope, priority revision 6. Base and refreshed canonical main `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`; contribution `a8ed09f187f4f596f25f257dfc1d4ce90c697d02`. All live source pins are canonical-main blobs, so cold CI needs no unrelated pending PR object.

Credit conorholds' covering-code source, Nick Petalas/PR3276/3244/3224, Krzysztof Wójt/PR3261, Nicholas Stone/PR2973 and successors, Ross Richardson/PR943, Douglas Colkitt/PR1185 and the retained coding/classification lineage. Automated drafting and implementation support was used; no independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed. [Canonical predecessor discussion](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1317). No human-directed Discussion post was made under the session restriction.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3276 leaves gap/caller coverage open. **After:** all 164 template/mode runs check every lexicographic gap rank, with 45,189,640 gap visits and 175,864 deterministic search handoffs. These are not scientific path-search nodes. Independent inclusion-exclusion counts agree with the coefficient oracle.
- Ten early-stop controls and four compiled semantic mutants pass their exact expected predicates. The actual Python caller rejects twelve incorrect/incomplete synthetic receipts; actual subprocess handling rejects nonzero exit, malformed JSON and timeout. Nine source/adapter-boundary controls pass.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15/GCC14 replay, warnings-as-errors, Ruff and address/undefined-behavior traversal checks pass. All twelve committed package/input byte comparisons and export integrity pass. The exact committed, read-only, Git-free export passes all three direct commands on optimized CPython 3.13.5 without foreign Git history.

```sh
python3.12 -I -W error -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/connector-caller-exhaustion-audit
```

README, TASK, SOURCES, RESULT and VERIFY contain the proof, exact inputs, commands, environment and Open next questions. Full native B exclusion and the literature/classification-to-walk reduction remain separate scientific obligations. Lean, Docker and selected cold replay are unrun. Hosted checks are separate and will be monitored on this exact head.

Pre-submission overlap covers 330 open PRs at 20:46:42 UTC. Discussions retain the complete 2,123-record snapshot at 20:37:52 UTC because their refresh hit a GraphQL rate limit. Actual peer reservations are disjoint. Closed/diff/unpublished completeness is not claimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated.

Adds one scoped audit package and bounded native workflow. Frozen predecessors, shared production code and selected result are unchanged. No family expansion is requested.
